phytonTests.name: Generic device basic composition
phytonTests.comment: Chip test bug: test_TC_DESC_2_1 fails on the Venetian Blind Closure device (DeviceType 560) and its Lift/Tilt Closure Panel children (DeviceType 561): their TagList entries use the Matter 1.6 Closure namespace family (0x44-0x46), which the bundled connectedhomeip TC_DeviceBasicComposition.py does not yet include in its accepted-namespace whitelist. Filed upstream: https://github.com/project-chip/connectedhomeip/issues/73479. See chipTests.md Known Issue #1.
